description: Show the signed-in user's next open tasks for one estate as a card in the chat: the same Up Next list their SwiftProbate dashboard shows, up to five tasks with due dates, which ones are overdue, and which are waiting on another task. Users who can edit the estate can tick a task to mark it done, and can tap Ask about this to get help with a task. Use this when the user asks what's next, what they should work on, or to see or check off their tasks, and they already have an estate set up. It needs an estate_id from list_my_estates; if they have more than one estate and haven't said which, ask. Do not use it to search tasks, filter by status or asset, or read a task's full details (use get_tasks or get_task_detail), or when the user has no estate yet (offer setup instead). The result lists the tasks shown, the total number of open tasks, and whether the user can edit. If the card can't be shown in this chat, summarize the tasks from the result instead. SwiftProbate is software that helps people organize the probate process; tasks are general guidance, not legal advice.

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.
